audit.reasoning: Quote check: the deciding sentence is verbatim on PDF p.1 of the held Orr 1991 excerpt (page image read), and the two exception passages are in the held scanned. The deciding source is a 1991 pedagogical lesson book (20-page excerpt), which is not the best available description, but the two better sources — O'Rourke & Swanson 2013 (JIPA Illustration, fetched sources now, pp.113-114) and Grzech 2016 (SOAS PhD grammar sketch, already held, §2.1.2.2 p.44, pitch-track-checked) — both state that Tena Quichua stress falls on the penultimate syllable by default, so the penultimate (non-strict, WORD-domain) coding stands. They refine the exception set: besides Orr's antepenultimate interrogatives (íma-ra) and non-shifting topic =ga, stress is word-final with LOC -i on polysyllabic V-final hosts, 3P -nun, purposive -ngax (3S -n variably), and in disyllabic ideophones; secondary stress may fall on the first o

sources.citation: O'Rourke, Erin & Tod D. Swanson. 2013. Tena Quichua. Journal of the International Phonetic Association 43(1): 107-120. doi:10.1017/S0025100312000266 (Illustrations of the IPA; open access on Cambridge Core)
sources.quote: 'Stress in Tena Quichua generally falls on the penultimate syllable (as shown in the examples in (1) above). However, a subset of suffixes causes stress to fall on the last syllable of the word, including: the locative (LOC) suffix when added to polysyllabic words ending in a vowel ..., third person singular /-n/ and plural /-nun/ present tense markers ..., and the suffix /-nɡax/ used to express future obligation' (p.113); 'There are also cases in which the addition of a suffix does not cause stress shift to the new penultimate syllable, as in the topic marker (TOP) /-ɡa/ (Orr 1991)' and varia
sources.locator: pp.113-114, section 'Prosodic features: Stress and intonation — Stress'
sources.note: JIPA Illustration with pitch/intensity tracks; our coding rests on a 1991 ILV lesson-book excerpt. fetched sources now; confirms penultimate default and adds suffix-conditioned final stress (LOC -i, 3S -n, 3P -nun, -ngax) plus non-shifting -ga.
